root_causes.description: fraud-detection pod experienced extreme memory pressure (z=+10.52, window=4.657e+08) far exceeding all other services, with baseline 4.577e+08±7.6e+05; this extreme anomaly likely causes degraded performance or incorrect behavior propagating through the topology to checkout and downstream services

cart service p99 latency spiked to z=+0.90 (window=3.979ms vs baseline 2.978±1.1ms), the highest latency anomaly across all services; may be downstream effect of fraud-detection memory stress propagating via checkout→cart, or independent issue

ad service memory usage spiked to z=+2.69 (window=4.712e+08 vs baseline 4.697e+08±5.3e+05), notable anomaly but 4x less extreme than fraud-detection's z=+10.52; may be related systemic issue or separate incident

remediation_steps: Investigate fraud-detection pod for OOM conditions or memory leaks; consider increasing memory limit or optimizing resource usage to address the z=+10.52 memory anomaly
Monitor cart latency and investigate if related to fraud-detection checkout dependency; add circuit breaker or backpressure if downstream effect confirmed
